limits: Normalized archive captures are partial laboratory recordings and include background activity.
An eligible recording has a supported bounded envelope; this does not authenticate its declared provenance or prove maliciousness.
Oversized captures need a bounded interval and are reported separately from structural inconsistencies.
This audit does not inspect model scores, execute samples or measure malware detection accuracy.
